description: `ActionExecutionService` runs cancellable server work with optional keyed locks. It is independent from `PlayerInputService`: input reports intent, while the gameplay system decides whether work succeeded, failed, or should be cancelled.

ActionExecution.luau.description: Owns one cancellable server operation and its optional lock permit. Public entry points include `ActionExecution.new`, `ActionExecution.GetActor`, `ActionExecution.HasTag`, `ActionExecution.GetStatus`, `ActionExecution.ObserveStatus`, `ActionExecution.IsActive`, `ActionExecution.GetCancelReason`, `ActionExecution.GetPromise`.

ActionExecutionService.luau.description: Starts cancellable server operations, coordinates optional keyed locks, and indexes active executions for dynamic interruption. Public entry points include `ActionExecutionService.Init`, `ActionExecutionService.TryStart`, `ActionExecutionService.GetActorExecutions`, `ActionExecutionService.CancelActorExecutions`, `ActionExecutionService.CancelActorExecutionsByTag`,…
